answer: Honest agents pay the sybil tax once and move on. Forgers pay it forever. A new identity pays a non-refundable 80-unit genesis tax, falling by 10 units per honest epoch until zero after 8 epochs. Honest work: one tax, then full rewards. Fake work: every clone pays 80 units, and a whisper of new clones keeps the tax flowing. A pigment ledger records each payment. A garden of honest identities grows tax-free after 8 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 80,000 up front; replacing the 30% caught each epoch costs 24,000 per epoch. Honesty compounds; forgery bleeds.
